# chalk_managed_aws_vpc (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk managed AWS VPC by ID. Use this data source to reference an existing VPC (e.g. its `designator`, subnets, or CIDR block) from a different Terraform root module.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) VPC identifier.

### Read-Only

- `additional_cidr_blocks` (List of String) Additional IPv4 CIDR blocks of the VPC.
- `additional_private_routes` (Attributes List) Additional private-subnet routes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_private_routes))
- `additional_public_routes` (Attributes List) Additional public-subnet routes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_public_routes))
- `cidr_block` (String) The primary IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC.
- `cloud_credential_id` (String) ID of the cloud credential used for the managed VPC.
- `designator` (String) VPC designator (suffix used by chalkadmin push commands).
- `name` (String) VPC name.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets configured on the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--additional_private_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `additional_private_routes`

Read-Only:

- `destination_cidr_block` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `peer_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--additional_public_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `additional_public_routes`

Read-Only:

- `destination_cidr_block` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `peer_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `private_cidr_block` (String)
- `public_cidr_block` (String)
